evidence.quote: After annealing at 800°C for 5, 15, and 30 min, B2 domains grew up to ~105, 210, and 430 nm, respectively (Fig. 3(b–e)).

According to EBSD analysis, annealing led to the formation of fully recrystallised microstructures (Fig. 1(a–d)), which average grain sizes increased with the annealing time from ~20 μm after 1 min to ~100 μm after 30 min (Fig. 1(e)).
The grain growth up to 50 μm (5 min) led to a steep degradation of mechanical properties, especially ductility.
the further grain growth up to 70–100 μm (15–30 min) resulted in more gradual softening and ductility reduction
